jobs.title: Synth codex — V1 scope from UI_REWORK.md
jobs.objective: Produce DESIGN_SYNTHESIS.md naming the exact V1 deliverables per RFC 0050 V1 scope + UI_REWORK.md §5 (component inventory) + §8 (implementation map) + §9 (acceptance). Cite UI_REWORK.md as canonical input. Do NOT re-derive design — RFC 0050 explicitly skips the design-ceremony triple because the handoff IS the design output. Output a phase-scope synthesis: which components ship in V1, which template partials, service.py payload-shape changes, dashboard.py text-mode parity work, CSS tokens, tests.

jobs.title: Review design claude — synthesis ↔ canonical handoff alignment
jobs.objective: Verify the synthesis tracks UI_REWORK.md V1 scope without scope drift. Reject if V1.5 / V2 work has bled in or V1 essentials are missing.

jobs.title: Implement codex — V1 components + payload + dashboard parity + tests
jobs.objective: Implement RFC 0050 V1 per the synthesis. Use sub-agents per concern: (1) frontend/src/shared/components/ TypeScript components per UI_REWORK.md §5; (2) templates/_components.html Jinja2 macros; (3) src/striatum/service.py page-payload shaping for run_list/run_detail/job_detail; (4) src/striatum/dashboard.py text-mode parity using the same chip vocabulary + next_actions list; (5) static/base.css semantic tokens (--status-*, --attestation-*, --override-marker, --evidence-not-yet-correlated); (6) tests/test_dashboard_web_parity.py + tests/test_byline_regression.py + tests/test_override_rationale_regression.py. Use V1.41 striatum byline + inbox verbs for any operator-on-behalf publishes; the V1.45.0 next_actions hook is the parity source-of-truth.

jobs.title: Build review codex threat_model
jobs.objective: Threat model: byline regression (no model byline for unattested sessions), override-rationale always rendered, LaneEvidenceChip never green pre-correlation, no transcript-capture surfaces.

jobs.title: Build review claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Ergonomics: dashboard ↔ web parity, copy-on-click identifiers, keyboard nav, ASCII chip glyphs.

jobs.title: Build review gemini adversarial
jobs.objective: Adversarial: byline forgery, override-rationale omission, transcript-capture leak, attestation-drift mid-flight.
